player_prompt.intro:
Owe udi mu kubeta Blackjack na mukalaba.
Kolomo yawe kufikia 21 bila kupita.
Pa kuse, sakula '[Hit]' ili kupeka kadi nyingine au '[Stand]' ili kubakisha.
J/Q/K = pointi 10; A = 11 to 1, kulingana na kile kilicho bora.
